bearing.event.v1alpha1.Actor.schema.json.description: Actor is who asked for an event.

subject.description:
What the authenticator proved: "token" for the API token, or
 "local:<uid>" for the socket's caller, or "system:<name>" for a Bearing
 component (the scheduler).

bearing.event.v1alpha1.Actor.schema.json.title: Actor

bearing.event.v1alpha1.LinkDecided.schem.description:
LinkDecided is a person's decision on an identity link (ADR 7: a proposed
 link becomes asserted only by a person or a rule the settings name). It is
 appended to the core/identity partition and applied in order, once.

^(linkId)$.description: The link ACCEPT, REJECT and UNDO_DISTINCT act on.

a.description:
For JOIN and SPLIT, the two records, each an entity ID, a record ID or
 a key; the store resolves them to records. Unused by the others.

actor.description: Who decided: what the authenticator proved. Never an agent.

link_id.description: The link ACCEPT, REJECT and UNDO_DISTINCT act on.

reason.description: Why, as free text. Optional, never interpreted, clipped to 1 KiB.

bearing.event.v1alpha1.LinkDecided.schem.title: Link Decided
